name: 4-MEC
summary: A substituted cathinone stimulant; little is known about its safety or subjective effects. It is believed to have similar effects to mephedrone, but with a lower potency and a stronger stimulating character.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: 4-MEC is reported to have been used as the active ingredient in fake "Ecstasy" pills in some countries such as New Zealand.
uses.recreational: Some users have injected the drug intravenously. It requires heating the water/4-MEC solution in order for 4-MEC to dissolve. Injecting 4-MEC appears to be rough on veins and is sometimes accompanied by a burning sensation. Therefore, 4-MEC should be diluted as much as possible.

pharmacology.en: Lab studies show a mixed action: it blocks the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline, and it causes serotonin to be released.
pharmacology.zh: 實驗室研究顯示它的作用是混合型的：它會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收，同時促進血清素釋放。
pharmacology.zhHans: 实验室研究显示它的作用是混合型的：它会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收，同时促进血清素释放。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia, anxiety, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、大量出汗、咬緊牙關、失眠、焦慮、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、大量出汗、咬紧牙关、失眠、焦虑、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: 4-MEC is the ethyl cousin of mephedrone. It has turned up as the active ingredient in fake ecstasy pills in countries such as New Zealand.
fact.zh: 4-MEC是喵喵（mephedrone）的乙基近親。在紐西蘭等國家，它曾被發現是假搖頭丸中的活性成分。
fact.zhHans: 4-MEC是喵喵（mephedrone）的乙基近亲。在新西兰等国家，它曾被发现是假摇头丸中的活性成分。
